name: entropy_regime_v1
author: claude-4.6-opus-agent-4
thesis: Shannon entropy of the distribution of 1-min returns measures the randomness/predictability of price action. Low entropy (returns clustered in a few bins) indicates structured, predictable market behavior — ideal for directional trading. High entropy (returns uniformly distributed) indicates random, unpredictable behavior — no edge. By computing the Shannon entropy of binned 1-min returns over a 50-bar rolling window and entering only during low-entropy periods (entropy < 70th percentile of historical distribution), we filter for predictable regimes. The inefficiency exists because entropy is an information-theoretic concept foreign to traditional technical analysis. Most traders have no concept of return distribution entropy.
stock_filter: ADV(20) > ₹100 Cr; sufficient tick activity for 1-min bars

indicators.name: Low_Entropy
indicators.params: True if Entropy_Pctile < 0.30 (bottom 30% of entropy = highly structured)

indicators.name: Dominant_Direction
indicators.params: sign(mean(Returns_1min, 50)) — direction of the structured returns

long.confirmation: Low_Entropy persists for at least 5 consecutive bars

short.confirmation: Low_Entropy persists for at least 5 consecutive bars

exit.trailing_stop: After 0.8 * ATR(14) profit, trail at 0.4 * ATR(14) from high-water mark
exit.signal_exit: Entropy_Pctile rises above 0.70 (regime shifting to high entropy / random)

filters.time_filter: No entries before 10:05 (need 50 bars for entropy computation) or after 15:10
filters.trend_filter: None — entropy-based filtering replaces trend filter
other_filters: Number of non-zero bins in histogram must be >= 5 (sufficient diversity for meaningful entropy)

edge.edge_decay_risk: Low — entropy computation from information theory is uncommon in trading; the concept is academically rigorous but practically obscure

weaknesses: Entropy computed on 50 1-min returns with 10 bins means most bins have 5 or fewer observations — the histogram is sparse, making the entropy estimate unreliable and sensitive to bin width choice
Low-entropy periods can coincide with low-volume lunch hours (12:00-13:00 IST) where returns are clustered near zero not because of structure but because of inactivity — false low-entropy signal
The 20-day historical entropy distribution used for percentile ranking may shift significantly during earnings season or macro events, invalidating the calibration
prior_art: Shannon (1948) information theory; Bandt & Pompe (2002) on permutation entropy for time series; Risso (2008) on entropy and stock market crashes; Hou & Li (2014) on information entropy and stock returns
notes: Consider using permutation entropy instead of Shannon entropy on binned returns — permutation entropy is more robust to small sample sizes and does not require arbitrary binning. Sample entropy (SampEn) is another alternative.
